checks.requirement: All 38 IDs match accepted M3/M4 exactly, with source SHAs.
No old fixture, SQL expression or approximate formula marked game computed Native.
Real label / native byte / player game identity / 3D vs SIM / snapshot date shown with appropriate per-axis evidence and UNKNOWN.
Changes build on 20 Reader families and source unit conventions, not a parallel system.
For every newly verified field: raw bytes/Getter source, decode, comparison and negative/alternate sample.
For implemented fields: read -> validate -> append unit -> typed query/export, independent same-unit readback.
No mutation to frozen v24 evidence DB; repeatable copy upgrade only if schema change required; row-level preservation.
Existing WorldData unit and SQLite smoke regression, old snapshot integrity, hidden Potential privacy and raw owner restrictions.
Fresh PID/process-create-time/native roots when runtime used; same input stable output; no stale pointer.
Only allowed file paths, no game/save/production modify, no forbidden injection, no master change.
M5 three pilot group data readiness and exact missing native stats enumerated; do not claim actual VAE experiment results.
Candidate HEAD, changed paths and remote verification actually performed; all partial status honest.

completion_candidate_condition: V01-V12 relevant checks actually executed; if no live accessible instance, explicitly classify blocked runtime and don't mark native integration verified; pass only achieved evidence scopes.
